children.name: add_file
children.label: Add file
children.tip: Pick a file, archive it, and get its shareable file: token.

children.name: find_hash
children.label: Fetch
children.tip: Fetch a file from others by its file: token (local network, Blossom) or a magnet: link (BitTorrent swarm).

children.name: q
children.label: Search
children.tip: Search your archive by text (name, description, tag, folder) or paste a sha256 to find one file.

children.name: folders
children.label: Folders
children.tip: Browse files grouped into virtual folders.

children.name: library
children.tip: Every file in the device's content-addressed archive. Tap an entry for details.

name: Folders
tip: Shared mutable folders. Each has a permanent id (its key); contents can change but the id stays. Others browse it by id; you grant moderators by their npub.

children.name: folder_new
children.label: New folder
children.tip: Create a folder you own (you hold its master key).

children.name: folder_add_disk
children.label: Add from disk
children.tip: Pick a directory on this device to share; files are served from disk (not copied). The master key is kept inside that folder.

children.name: folder_use
children.label: Use this folder
children.tip: While browsing disk: share the current directory.

children.name: folder_open_id
children.label: Open by id
children.tip: Browse any folder by its id (hex) or npub address.

children.name: folder_manage
children.label: Manage
children.tip: Download all, auto-sync, and owner edits (add files, rename, link, admins, rescan).

children.name: folders
children.tip: Your folders, or the open folder's contents. Tap to open.

name: Sharing
tip: Make your archive available to others.

children.name: provide
children.tip: Two transports: Blossom HTTP for devices on the same local network, and BitTorrent for anyone across the internet.

children.name: blossom_on
children.label: Share on the local network (Blossom)
children.tip: Serve GET /<sha256> over HTTP so nearby devices can scan this port and fetch your files. NOSTR-Blossom compatible.

children.name: uploads_on
children.label: Accept uploads (PUT /upload)
children.tip: Allow others to store files on this device. Uploads are keyed by their own hash, so nobody can overwrite an existing file.

children.name: seed_on
children.label: Seed over BitTorrent (internet)
children.tip: Create a deterministic torrent for every archived file and announce it to well-known public trackers + the DHT, so devices on other networks can fetch it from the swarm via its magnet link.

children.name: share_apply
children.label: Apply sharing
children.tip: Start/stop the transports with the settings above.
